feature: Gate evidence reader and history-anchored seals
description: A gate passes only on output that proves tests ran and passed, or when a person has declared it uncounted. A sealed test's expected hash comes from git history and its amendment chain, never from the editable JSON.

specs.description: A sealed file whose bytes match its blob at the red commit holds
specs.given: a sealed file tests/a.rs with at_red = H0, no amendments, recorded = H0, current = H0
specs.when: judge_seal("tests/a.rs", Some(H0), [], Some(H0), Some(H0)) is called

specs.description: An amendment chain moves the expected hash
specs.given: at_red = H0, and one amendment for tests/a.rs with from = H0 and to = H1, recorded = H1, current = H1

specs.description: Amendments for other files do not apply
specs.given: at_red = H0, and one amendment for tests/b.rs with from = X and to = Y, recorded = H0, current = H0
specs.when: judge_seal is called for tests/a.rs with that amendment list

specs.description: A loosened test whose new hash was written into the JSON by hand is refused as Rewritten
specs.given: at_red = H0, no amendments, recorded = H1, current = H1, where H1 ≠ H0
specs.then: the verdict is Rewritten, not Holds

specs.description: A file edited after sealing is Edited
specs.given: at_red = H0, no amendments, recorded = H0, current = H2, where H2 ≠ H0

specs.description: An amendment whose from does not continue the chain is a broken chain at its index
specs.given: at_red = H0, and amendments for tests/a.rs [ {from H0, to H1}, {from H9, to H2} ], where H9 ≠ H1, recorded = H2, current = H2

specs.description: hexa spec verify fails on an edited, rewritten or broken-chain seal
specs.given: a spec whose sealed file judges as Edited, Rewritten or BrokenChain
specs.when: hexa spec verify runs on that spec
specs.then: it exits non-zero and names the file and its verdict

specs.description: The JSON record never moves the expected hash
specs.given: any at_red hash H0, any amendment list whose chain for the file is unbroken and ends at E, and any recorded hash R ≠ E
specs.when: judge_seal is called with current = E

specs.description: An unbroken chain with matching record and file always holds
specs.given: any H0 and any chain of amendments for the file where each from equals the previous to, ending at E
specs.when: judge_seal is called with recorded = E and current = E

specs.description: A file with no blob at the red commit is Unanchored
specs.given: at_red = None, no amendments, recorded = H0, current = H0

specs.description: verify --ci fails an unanchored seal by name
specs.given: a spec whose red commit is not an ancestor of HEAD
specs.then: it exits non-zero and names the unanchored file; it does not report the spec green

specs.description: Re-anchoring with --red-at restores trust
specs.given: a spec whose red commit is gone from history, and a commit C in history at which its tests existed and failed
specs.when: hexa spec tests --red-at C runs and then hexa spec verify --ci runs
specs.then: the seals judge against the blob at C, and verify no longer reports them Unanchored

specs.description: No anchor means never Holds
specs.given: any file, amendments, recorded and current values
specs.when: judge_seal is called with at_red = None

specs.description: An agent run is checked against HEAD's seals
specs.given: HEAD's spec JSON seals tests/a.rs, and the working tree's JSON has had its sealed map removed
specs.when: hexa do runs and its change edits tests/a.rs
specs.then: the run is refused as an edit to a sealed test, because seals were read from HEAD

specs.description: A run that touches a spec JSON is refused and restored
specs.given: a hexa do or hexa harden run
specs.then: the file is restored, nothing is committed, and the refusal names docs/specs/ADR-X.json

specs.description: A sealed file deleted by a run is an edit
specs.given: HEAD lists and tracks a sealed file tests/a.rs
specs.then: the seal is judged Gone and the run is refused

specs.description: A sealed file absent both at HEAD and after the run is not an edit (issue #50)
specs.given: a sealed map listing tests/old.rs, which is not tracked at HEAD
specs.then: the run is not refused on account of tests/old.rs

specs.description: cargo test with passing tests reads as Passed
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output containing "test result: ok. 5 passed; 0 failed"

specs.description: The Node 23+ spec reporter is recognised
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output with lines "ℹ tests 4", "ℹ pass 4", "ℹ fail 0"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: The node --test TAP summary is recognised
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output with "# tests 3", "# pass 3", "# fail 0"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: The hexa spec verify summary is recognised
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output containing "6 passed · 0 failed"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: A reported failure fails even with exit 0
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output containing "test result: FAILED. 4 passed; 1 failed"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: An empty node --test run is Vacuous
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output with "# tests 0", "# pass 0", "# fail 0"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: Silent or unknown output is Unrecognised
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output that is empty, or is "all good"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: A non-zero exit fails regardless of output
specs.given: exit_ok = false and output containing "test result: ok. 5 passed; 0 failed"
specs.when: read_evidence is called without the uncounted declaration

specs.description: Passed requires exit 0, at least one test, and no reported failure
specs.given: any exit_ok and any output
specs.when: read_evidence(exit_ok, output, false) returns Passed { tests }
specs.then: exit_ok is true, tests ≥ 1, and no recognised line in output reports a failed test

specs.description: A non-zero exit is always Failed
specs.given: any output

specs.description: Only Passed (or a declared Uncounted) passes
specs.given: the values Passed { tests: 1 } and Uncounted

specs.description: Vacuous, Unrecognised and Failed do not pass
specs.given: the values Vacuous, Unrecognised and Failed { reason: "x" }

specs.description: A gate of `true` is refused by every gate consumer
specs.given: a gate command `true` that exits 0 and prints nothing, not declared uncounted
specs.when: hexa do, hexa adr gates or hexa loop stage done runs that gate
specs.then: it fails, reports the output as unrecognised, and lists the runners the reader knows

specs.description: Closing a stage with no recorded gate fails
specs.given: a loop stage with no gate recorded
specs.then: it fails and says that no gate is recorded

specs.description: A vacuous gate fails as measured nothing
specs.given: a gate whose run reads as Vacuous
specs.then: it fails with a message saying the gate measured nothing

specs.description: passes is true exactly for Passed and Uncounted
specs.given: any Evidence value e
specs.then: it is true if and only if e is Passed { .. } or Uncounted

specs.description: A declared uncounted gate that exits 0 is Uncounted
specs.given: exit_ok = true, output "build finished", and the uncounted declaration

specs.description: Uncounted results are labelled wherever they are reported
specs.given: a gate declared with hexa do run … --uncounted that exits 0
specs.when: hexa do reports the result and writes its commit
specs.then: the report line and the commit message both contain the word "uncounted"

specs.description: A declared uncounted gate that exits non-zero fails
specs.given: exit_ok = false and the uncounted declaration

specs.description: Unrecognised output is never treated as uncounted without the declaration
specs.given: exit_ok = true and output "build finished"

specs.description: Uncounted is produced only by the declaration
specs.given: any exit_ok and any output

specs.description: For a declared uncounted gate, the exit status alone decides
specs.given: any output
specs.then: the result passes if and only if exit_ok is true

specs.description: Coverage is reported from a gate that passes on the intact tree
specs.given: a gate whose run on the unmodified tree reads as Passed
specs.then: it first runs the gate once on the unmodified tree, then reports coverage

specs.description: A failing gate yields no coverage
specs.given: the gate `false`
specs.then: it reports no coverage and no hole count, gives the reason, and exits non-zero

specs.description: A vacuous or unrecognised baseline yields no coverage
specs.given: a gate whose run on the unmodified tree reads as Vacuous or Unrecognised, and which is not declared uncounted
specs.then: it reports no coverage, names the reason, and exits non-zero

specs.description: A declared uncounted gate that exits 0 on the intact tree is measured
specs.given: a gate declared uncounted that exits 0 on the unmodified tree
